subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Christian Last Judgment
description: Learn Christian Last Judgment in one minute.

hook.text: In Christian belief, all the dead will rise at the end of time. Christ will separate sheep from goats.

buildup.text: Heaven for the saved. Hell for the damned. Purgatory for those who need final cleansing—in Catholic belief.

discovery.text: Michelangelo painted the Last Judgment on the Sistine Chapel. Christ gestures upward and downward at once.

twist.text: Protestant reformers rejected purgatory. Calvin said your fate was decided before birth—predestination.

climax.text: The Last Judgment is collective, not personal. Everyone is judged together. Your fate is public.

quiz.question: What did Protestant reformers like Calvin reject about the afterlife?
